newsitem.title: FINLAND: Baltic Ice - Ice receding, most restrictions steady.
newsitem.headline: Baltic Ice - Ice receding, most restrictions steady.

text.p: Ice melted slowly and all Finnish restrictions to navigation remained in force, the Finnish Institute of Marine Research said in its twice-weekly ice report on Thursday.
In Sweden, all restrictions to the port of Umea was lifted, an institute official said.
One ice-breaker was assisting ships outside Loviisa, Kotka and Hamina and five icebreakers were in action near St Petersburg and Vyborg in the eastern Gulf of Finland.

Five ice-breakers were operating in the northern end of the Gulf of Bothnia and two in the middle, and one remained on station outside Parnu in the Gulf of Riga, the institute said.(Temperatures of nearby isotherms, degrees Celsius)

NOTES: New ice - forming, thin and still moving. Fast ice - not moving level flat ice. Level ice - thick flat ice. Consolidated/compact - compact close ice. Windrow ice - reshaped by wind, thickness varies sharply. Rafted - ridges forming, 10-20 cm thick. Ridged - ridged or hummocked ice. Open - floes with water at rate of 4-6:10. Close ice - floes tightly packed.
